newsitem.title: USA: Cumberland Cty, N.C., mulls $98 mln school bonds.
newsitem.headline: Cumberland Cty, N.C., mulls $98 mln school bonds.

text.p: A Cumberland County, N.C., school committee has recommened a referendum on $98 million of general obligation bonds for school construction and repairs, the Fayetteville-Observer Times reported.
The newspaper said the school board would decide next week whether to take the recommendation of the school facilities committee to county commissioners for approval.

The county needs $171 million of new construction. It is currently eligible for $60 million from statewide school construction bonds approved by voters in November. Under the matching formula, Cumberland County's share of the state bond proceeds would rise to $73.3 million if it issues the $98 million of local bonds.
The proposal would finance construction of six new schools and repairs at several others.
